events.title: Balance & Loot Update
events.summary: Balance & Loot Update Your upgrades hit harder Every upgrade and ability now deals 1.5x damage — base shots are untouched. To balance it out you'll find slightly fewer upgrades per run, so each pick matters more. Choose wisely. Marked targets Some enemies now spawn carrying serious loot, and you'll spot them instantly by their glow: Gold aura — a hoard of coins that erupts on kill Blue aura — they're carrying an upgrade Hunt them down. Minor fixes Damage-over-time effects now tick consistently E

events.title: Gadgets Update
events.summary: Gadgets Update - Portals Grew Into a Whole Toolbelt The big one: gadgets! Portals used to just... happen when you blinked. Now you've got a proper toolbelt of gadgets you place and trigger yourself with L2 (left Alt on keyboard): Portals - place them where YOU want. Shoot through one, your shots come out the other. events.title: Combo changes and new gamemode!
events.summary: Combo Overhaul Update Combo Rework Big combo overhaul. You now lose your combo when you take damage, and all bonuses reset. Combo bonuses have been nerfed. You can no longer rely on building a combo alone. You also need to pick upgrades to pump up your base stats. Combo HUD Overhaul Sparks, booms, punches! Way more satisfying feedback. events.title: New effects, real voices
events.summary: New effects, real voicesQuick update on what's new in the demo. New visual effects are live: projectile trails, on-hit effects, and lingering area effects to make the chaos read better on screen. Myles and Myles' dad now have real narrators. They're voiced by playtesters who've been helping me with the game. Thanks for stepping up.

events.title: Deflect meta progression nerfs and Myles is back on the minimap!

He went off the grid when he also became a quest, that's fixed now. events.title: New loot reward visual and New Myles UI and he now does deals!
events.summary: New loot reward! It works just like before, but it's way juicier and hits those dopamine receptors real good! New shop! Fresh look, and Myles now often has limited-time deals! What deals can you find out in the world? Myles is now way more interesting to seek out and talk to — better deals for everyone!

events.title: Faster loadtimes, buildings is now quests and more hookshoting
events.summary: Faster loads and new quests Faster loads with semi-procedural generation. Loads were taking too long. The thing eating all that time was the scene generating procedural terrain and then baking the mesh. Now the terrain always looks the same, buildings in the same place. The rest is still procedural. Much faster load times, at the cost of some things no longer being procedural. This opens up a world of possibilities. Check the next point to see what kind. Tell me what you think! Added building qu

events.title: Burst and buckshot fixes, 2 new minibosses
events.summary: Burstshot fixed. It now shoots in bursts again. This behaviour was lost when transitioning to projectile pooling, now it's back as it should be. Buckshot nerfed. Buckshot was way too overpowered and needed a nerf. We've increased its spread, so you're rewarded for getting up close. Up close it obliterates. From far away your shots spread out and most of them miss. 2 new minibosses added: an evil wizard with a spokewheel attack, and a Naga with a fanshot attack.

events.title: Smoother pacing, better performance (enemy pooling) and a minor bugfix
events.summary: Performance update: I've increased performance by pooling enemies instead of destroying and creating new ones all the time. This boosts performance especially in the lategame, and makes the game harder to push to its limit for those of you with high-end hardware. For those of you with lower-end hardware, you'll now be able to push a hardware break even further. How far can you get on a Steam Deck? What's your record combo? events.title: Small fixes with huge impact. Droprate of upgradees and chests
events.summary: Fixed a bug where reels bypassed item drop weighting. All reels in the loot reward now respect item drop rates. Fixed elite enemy drop rate that was set to 10x what was intended.

events.title: Projectile patterns droprate decrease and pause saftey
events.summary: Reduced drop rate for all projectile patterns (Buckshot, Burstshot, Pingpong, Corkscrew, Flakshot, etc.) and for pattern related upgrades (e.g. Flanking Crits). All of these are now set to 1/5 of their previous drop rate. Fixed a pause bug on loading screens. After loading finished, while waiting for player input, you could still pause and unpause the game. That's now fixed, no more pausing during load screens. Fixed a bug where the game could sometimes be unpaused if a hitstop happened on the s

events.title: Combo bonuses boost and nerf (w00t?), performance fixes
events.summary: Combo Rework + Performance Update Combo has been reworked. The reason: combo bonuses were taking over every build by the end of a run. They were too strong when fully upgraded and too weak without. Combos now have a higher base bonus, and the shop upgrades add +20% per upgrade, for a max of +100% on top of the base. Fixed vendor/Myles upgrades (discounts and upgraded rarity) so they now reset correctly between runs. Enemy spawner rework: enemy cap lowered from 250 to 175. events.title: New deflect aura for incoming projectiles, rarity for reel, stronger luck
events.summary: New patch is up, here's what changed: New deflect aura replaces the old incoming-projectile warning. It makes it much clearer exactly when you can deflect. Cactus enemy is no longer counterable, its projectiles can only be deflected. Luck upgrade now also gives a chance for double loot crate spawns + meta coins. events.summary: Wider map reveal. You now uncover more of the world as you explore. Both the minimap and the full-screen map reveal a larger area around you. Settings Your "Gentleman's Game Break" choice in the main menu now sticks between sessions.
